# Reference answer to the unseen UX Randori round (round U)

Kept out of the site on purpose: publishing it would make the round seen. The site's tests run
`public/examples/ux-pathway/tools/ux_review.mjs` on these two flows: `first.json` (the sitemap drawn before the
partner showed the card) must pass every structural check and miss the hidden constraint; `adapted.json` must pass
every row the script judges. Written by the maintainers, who also wrote the card, so it is a check of the rubric and
the tool, not evidence that anyone has done the round unseen.
